blocks.en: Human visual reasoning is driven by systematic exploration and extraction of task-relevant visual evidence. Human gaze provides a window into this process, making gaze a useful source of guidance for visually-grounded reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs). However, human gaze also includes noise and redundancies that may transfer poorly to VLMs. In this work, we investigate how human gaze data can be effectively leveraged to improve visual reasoning in VLMs, while maintaining alignment with human behavior. We collect 7,109 human gaze trials from a diverse and challenging set of visual reasoning tasks, and train grounded reasoning models with different forms of gaze guidance. Across evaluations in chart understanding, visual search, and counting, we find that using human gaze as a prior for grounded reasoning consistently outperforms supervision using the full gaze sequence. Based on these findings, we introduce GGR (Gaze-Guided Reasoner), which achieves greater human alignment and more reliable visual grounding while matching or outperforming leading grounded-reasoning baselines in accuracy. Reinforcement learning further improves task accuracy, gaze alignment, and grounding quality despite using no gaze supervision. Behavioral analyses show that gaze supervised models exhibit more visual exploration before arriving at an answer. Our results suggest that the value of human gaze lies in guiding spatial exploration and shaping reasoning behavior without requiring complete imitation of human behavior.
blocks.zh: 人类视觉推理由系统探索和提取与任务相关的视觉证据所驱动. 人类的目光为这一过程提供了一个窗口,使目光成为视觉语言模型(VLMs)中以视觉为基础的推理的有用指导来源. 然而,人类的目光还包括噪音和冗余,这些噪音和冗余可能不良地转移到VLM上. 在这部作品中,我们调查如何有效地利用人视星等数据来改进VLMs中的视觉推理,同时保持与人类行为的一致性. 我们收集了7 109次人类目光试验 从一组多样而有挑战性的视觉推理任务, 并训练有不同形式目光指导的 基础推理模型。 在图表理解、视觉搜索和计数方面的评价中,我们发现,利用人类的目光作为有根据的推理的先导,始终比利用全部目光序列进行监督的要好。 基于这些调查结果,我们引入了GGR(Gaze-Guided Reasoner),实现了更大的人与人之间的对接和更加可靠的视觉地基定位,同时精确地匹配或优于领先的地基地基基线. 加强学习可进一步提高任务准确性、目视一致性和定位质量,尽管没有使用目视监督。 行为分析显示,在给出答案之前,被监视的模型表现出更多的视觉探索. 我们的结果显示,人类凝视的价值在于指导空间探索和塑造推理行为而不需要完全模仿人类行为.
